# Cluster (DESY Maxwell) dependency set for the cw2 / MetaWorld runs.
#
# This is deliberately NOT deps/requirements.txt. That file pins the stack the
# SimbaV2 paper's numbers were produced with (jax 0.4.25, numpy 1.24, mujoco
# 3.1.6, a pre-1.0 gymnasium commit, d4rl) and is the right thing to reproduce
# DMC/HumanoidBench results. MetaWorld 3.x needs gymnasium >= 1.1 and mujoco 3.3,
# which that set cannot satisfy.
#
# The pins below match the environment the sibling RLAC repo already runs
# MetaWorld on, so both projects can share one node image and one set of
# hardware assumptions:
#   conda create -n simbav2_env python=3.10
#   pip install -r deps/requirements_maxwell.txt
# See deps/setup_maxwell.sh, which does that plus the git dependencies.

# --- JAX (CUDA 12). Drop the two jax-cuda12-* lines for a CPU-only install. ---
jax==0.6.0
jaxlib==0.6.0
jax-cuda12-plugin==0.6.0
jax-cuda12-pjrt==0.6.0
flax==0.10.5
optax==0.2.4
chex==0.1.89
tensorflow-probability==0.25.0

numpy==2.2.5
scipy==1.15.2

# --- envs ---
gymnasium==1.1.1
mujoco==3.3.1
# MetaWorld itself is a git dependency -- see deps/setup_maxwell.sh:
#   pip install "git+https://github.com/dongtian-code/Metaworld.git@dt_branch"

# --- config / launcher ---
hydra-core==1.3.2
omegaconf==2.3.0
dotmap==1.3.30
PyYAML==6.0.2
# cw2 is a git dependency (the dt_branch fork) -- see deps/setup_maxwell.sh.

# --- logging ---
wandb==0.19.9
# Pinned: wandb 0.19.9's protobuf dispatcher only branches on major versions
# "3"/"4"/"5". With protobuf 6/7 installed it imports the wrong generated module
# and dies with "cannot import name 'Deprecated' from wandb.proto.wandb_telemetry_pb2".
protobuf==5.29.4
tqdm==4.67.1
imageio==2.37.0
